title: Resilient concurrent gather
prompt:
Implement `gather(urls, fetch, workers=4)` using a `ThreadPoolExecutor`:

- run `fetch(url)` for every url with up to `workers` concurrent tasks
- return a tuple `(results, errors)`
- `results` maps url → fetch result for successful calls
- `errors` maps url → the exception's string message for failed calls
- one failing url must never prevent others from completing
boilerplate:
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

# TODO: gather(urls, fetch, workers=4)

tests.name: all results collected, failures isolated
tests.hint: Wrap fut.result() in try/except and record per-url outcomes; as_completed lets each future report its own fate.

tests.name: empty input, zero workers worth of work
tests.hint: An empty batch returns two empty dicts — no special cases needed.
